title: Yellow Dense Japanese Gobo Burdock Wagashi
description: A traditional Japanese dessert featuring gobo burdock, with a citrusy and dense texture, made with a mother sauce base and ayurvedic tamasic friendly ingredients.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine grated gobo burdock, mother sauce base, rice flour, yellow food coloring, lemon juice, sugar, water, and salt, and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Divide the dough into small balls, about 1 inch in diameter.
Shape each ball into a small oval shape, resembling a wagashi.
Place the shaped wagashi on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Steam the wagashi over boiling water for 10 minutes, or until they are cooked through and firm to the touch.
Allow the wagashi to cool to room temperature.
If desired, garnish with yuzu zest before serving.
